_notes.asSystemExits: Raised 96 to 191 in A6 fix round 1 (L1): the count is now every use of a function holding an asSystem call (eslint-rules/as-system-exits.mjs, the TypeScript parser), not every site that is no door plus the calls of one exact door shape. Nothing new leaves the scope; the old count missed uses: a conditional wrapper (heartbeatRow, 2 sites, 6 uses), and every function holding a site that is not of the door shape, counted once although many places call it: loadProfilePreferences 57 (owner-preferences), upsertFile 19 (kind-root), searchNodes 6, turnHeartbeats 2, withOriginScope 2, markExportClientSourced 3, contactSharingByContact 3, fileNameTaken 3 and others. An exported holder's uses in other files count (a named or destructured import, a namespace call); a renamed import is refused. Before: 96 after main dropped the two provider-key exits (98 in round 2, 94 in round 1). Unchanged at 191 after the rebase onto v0.300.59 (A9's runtime role, the search across workspaces and A8's seat read, moderatorSeatsNow in packages/db, add no asSystem use). 191 is far above the plan's 40: docs/actors.md, A6, lists every holder with its uses.
_notes.routePolicyLists: raised 16 to 17 in A10 #8: ROUTE_GATES (server/web/lib/route-limits.ts) gives each row its named rate limits and its cross-site refusal, read into the row by buildRouteRow (two ROUTE_POLICY fields), where 38 limits were taken by hand in route files (32 calls in 26 files) and helpers. Raised 15 to 16 in A4 hand batch B fix round 1 (M2): PUBLIC_LOGIN_ROWS (route-policy.ts) names the public rows that read a login, so buildRouteRow refuses a public login kind on any other public row (the /s link routes, the remote MCP, federation, sign-in). It is ROUTE_POLICY's own check of the rows, as FRAME_ROWS is, not a policy beside them.
